name: com.agentsecurityindex/agent-security-index
title: Agent Security Index
description: Read-only directory of AI agent security tools: search, get, compare, list categories.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the Agent Security Index directory of AI agent security tools (guardrails, MCP gateways and scanners, runtime security, red teaming, identity, observability). All filters are optional and combined with AND. 'query' is a case-insensitive substring search over name, slug, vendor and description; multiple words must all match. 'category' accepts a category slug or its full name (case-insensitive exact match). 'license' is a case-insensitive substring match (for example 'mit' or 'apache'). Returns up to 'limit' compact records (default 10, max 25) plus total_matches. Read-only.

query.description: Free-text search over name, slug, vendor and description.

category.description: Category slug or category name, e.g. 'mcp-security'. See list_categories.

free.description: true: only tools with a free or $0 option. false: only tools without one.

license.description: Case-insensitive substring of the license, e.g. 'mit', 'apache-2.0'.

open_source.description: true: only open source tools. false: only non open source tools.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Fetch the full verified record for one tool, including pricing, license, vendor, parent company, derived open_source and free flags, last_verified date and source URLs. Provide 'id' (accepts a slug or an exact tool name), or 'slug', or 'name'. Case-insensitive. If several are given, id takes precedence over slug, then name. Returns an error result if not found.

id.description: Tool slug or exact tool name, e.g. 'lakera-guard'.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all categories in the Agent Security Index with slug, name, description and the number of tools in each. Use the slug as the 'category' filter of search_tools. Takes no arguments.

tools.name: compare_tools
tools.description: Compare 2 to 5 tools side by side by slug: name, url, category, description, model, pricing, license, open_source, free, vendor, github_repo, last_verified and a link to the tool page on https://agentsecurityindex.com. Unknown slugs are listed in not_found; at least 2 known tools are needed.

slugs.description: Between 2 and 5 unique tool slugs, e.g. ['lakera-guard', 'llm-guard'].
